description: This PHP source file defines the 'Forgotten' controller class within the Opencart admin system, handling password reset and forgotten password functionalities including views, validation, token management, and user interactions.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Controller class for handling forgotten password functionalities including viewing reset pages, confirming email submissions, resetting passwords, and validating tokens.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the forgotten password page, redirecting logged-in users or if mail engine is disabled.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles the submission of the email address to initiate password reset, generating token, and redirecting upon success or failure.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Prepares the password reset form if a valid token is provided, otherwise redirects to login.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Processes password change requests, validating the new password, and updating user credentials.
